scenes.title: Ссора из-за поцелуя  (A Quarrel Over a Kiss)
scenes.summary: Kostya furiously confronts Max at the Claude Monet bar after discovering Max kissed Nastya the previous evening.

scenes.title: Мечты о будущем  (Dreams of the Future)
scenes.summary: In the waitstaff locker room, waitress Nastya excitedly confides in Sasha about kissing Max and already envisions their future family and children.

scenes.title: Операция «Треска»  (Operation Cod)
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor Barinov convenes a kitchen staff briefing after discovering thawed cod, commanding Sasha to aggressively push fish specials with a twenty percent discount.

scenes.title: Неловкое расставание  (An Awkward Breakup)
scenes.summary: Max meets waitress Nastya in the vegetable storeroom to explain they are not dating and that their romance was a misunderstanding.

scenes.title: Кулинарный спор  (A Culinary Bet)
scenes.summary: Max arrives late to the kitchen and gets scolded by Chef Barinov, before fish cook Fedya insults Max's skills, triggering a cooking bet.

scenes.title: Кулинарная битва  (A Culinary Battle)
scenes.summary: Senya takes bets from the kitchen crew as Fedya and Max prepare to compete in a cooking duel using cod as the main ingredient.

scenes.title: Слёзы Насти  (Nastya's Tears)
scenes.summary: In the staff hallway behind the dining room, art director Victoria finds waitress Nastya crying after an argument with Max. Victoria gives her practical advice on dealing with heartbreak and urges her to focus on work.

scenes.title: Звонок от мамы  (Call from Mom)
scenes.summary: In the noisy restaurant kitchen, cook Senya calls Max over to answer an unexpected phone call from his mother in Voronezh. Max pretends to chat with his mom while secretly receiving cooking instructions for a trout dish.

scenes.title: Поддержка подруги  (A Friend's Support)
scenes.summary: In the quiet service area, waitress Nastya is sobbing after her painful breakup with Max. Her close colleague Sasha comes over to comfort her, telling her not to waste tears on a careless cook and reminding her of her worth.

scenes.title: Тайное поручение  (A Secret Errand)
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor Barinov pulls Max aside in the kitchen to give him a secret mission: fetch a bottle of cognac from the bar under the pretext of getting cooking ingredients.

scenes.title: План мести  (A Plan of Revenge)
scenes.summary: In the locker room, heartbroken waitress Nastya confides in her friend Sasha, who persuades her to take revenge on Max by dating his best friend, the bartender Kostya.

scenes.title: Решительный шаг  (A Decisive Step)
scenes.summary: Encouraged by Sasha's reassurance that Kostya has feelings for her, Nastya wipes away her tears and decides to approach the bar counter.

scenes.title: Предупреждение от Вики  (A Warning from Vika)
scenes.summary: In the kitchen of Claude Monet, restaurant administrator Vika confronts young cook Max with an eggplant in hand. Furious that waitress Nastya has been crying all day, Vika delivers an unmistakable warning before leaving Max to finish his soup.

scenes.title: Разговор в кладовой  (Talk in the Pantry)
scenes.summary: Stepping away from the bustling restaurant floor, waitress Nastya leads bartender Kostya into a secluded pantry. Gathering her courage, she asks him whether he genuinely wants to start dating her, prompting Kostya to happily confess his feelings.

scenes.title: Кулинарный вердикт  (The Culinary Verdict)
scenes.summary: In the kitchen of Claude Monet, Chef Barinov and cook Max await Victoria's final decision on the competitive fish tasting. Victoria lavishly praises the winning dish while ruthlessly condemning the loser's creation, leaving the triumphant head chef in high spirits.

scenes.title: Укромный уголок  (A Secluded Corner)
scenes.summary: Nastya pulls Kostya into a secluded backroom of the restaurant to speak privately without any witnesses.

scenes.title: Невинный обман  (An Innocent Deception)
scenes.summary: Nastya confesses she wanted to use Kostya for revenge, so they agree to pretend they are dating without actually doing anything.

scenes.title: Рыбный экзамен  (The Fish Exam)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov promotes Max to handle all fish orders, then secretly orchestrates an avalanche of cod orders to test him.

scenes.title: Хитрый план  (A Cunning Plan)
scenes.summary: In the dining room, Sasha debriefs with bartender Kostya about their plan to make Max jealous, and Kostya cleverly turns their fake cover story into a real movie date.

scenes.title: Просьба о помощи  (A Request for Help)
scenes.summary: Swamped with dinner orders on the kitchen line, Max swallows his pride to ask Fedya for help, prompting Fedya to playfully demand a public apology before stepping in.

scenes.title: Запара в голове  (Rush in the Head)
scenes.summary: Seeing Max overwhelmed by the intense dinner rush, veteran fish cook Fedya steps in to teach him breathing techniques and the golden rule: the rush is only in your head.

scenes.title: Не торопись  (Take Your Time)
scenes.summary: Applying Fedya's calming advice, Max carefully cooks and plates the fish orders during the rush while Fedya coaches him to work steadily without rushing.

scenes.title: Конец трудного дня  (End of a Difficult Day)
scenes.summary: After surviving a chaotic kitchen rush, Max reflects on the hardships of the day, while Barinov places a football bet and the staff prepare for tomorrow.
